pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Avoid Inventing Prior Customer Interaction Details
lesson.when: The user refers generally to a previous inquiry or callback without verified record of the specific item or issue in provided evidence
lesson.do: Ask the user politely which product or policy they are considering, without claiming specific SKUs or previous concerns
lesson.otherwise: State clearly that the specific past details are not available in current records and ask how to assist
triggers: chưa có lịch sử tư vấn
